tiktok_title: Tier list tontonan anak: yang pelan vs yang serba cepat. Masuk tier mana?
caption:
Kartun yang ganti adegan tiap detik bikin anak anteng, tapi ada harganya. Di studi Lillard & Peterson (2011), anak 4 tahun yang nonton kartun serba cepat 9 menit lebih susah fokus dan nahan diri sesudahnya, dibanding yang nonton acara pelan atau menggambar. Itu efek sesaat, jangka panjangnya belum diketahui.

Ini tier list kami, tanpa sebut judul: S nonton bareng sambil ngobrol, A acara pelan tentang kehidupan sehari-hari, B lagu dan gerak yang bikin dia ikut joget, C serba cepat dan autoplay terus.

Di bawah 2 tahun, WHO nyaranin sebaiknya tanpa layar. 2-4 tahun paling lama 1 jam sehari.

Tontonan anakmu masuk tier mana?

Sumber: Lillard & Peterson 2011 (Pediatrics), AAP (healthychildren.org), WHO 2019

sources: Lillard AS, Peterson J. The immediate impact of different types of television on young children's executive function. Pediatrics 2011. 4-year-olds watched 9 minutes of a fast-paced fantastical cartoon, a slower realistic show, or drew. The fast-paced group did significantly worse on executive-function tests right after. Drawing and the slow show were similar. Only immediate effects were measured. https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/674899

AAP healthychildren.org: co-view and talk about what children watch, choose high-quality programming. https://www.healthychildren.org/English/family-life/Media/Pages/Screen-Time-and-Temper-Tantrums-Helpful-Tips-for-Parents.aspx
WHO 2019, Guidelines on physical activity, sedentary behaviour and sleep for children under 5: screen time not recommended under 2 years, no more than 1 hour for 2 to 4 years.
notes: SHORT format (4 slides), job comment (tier letters). Deliberately no show titles, characters or logos, so we don't run into IP or 'bashing' a show. The tier order is our editorial view, said so ('tier list kami'). Only tier C and the co-viewing tier rest on sources. New art: tools/mkart_w5_C.py.
